also: it amounts to the same thing
it comes to the same thing
it’s all the same to me

evidence: Traupman 107: it’s all the same to me, meā nihil interest
Traupman 212: Meā nihil interest, it makes no difference to me
Plaut. Pers. 537: meā quidem istuc nīl rēfert
terms.comment: To me, to you: nīl meā (tuā) interest or rēfert (Traupman 96).

terms.gloss: I’m content with it, it’s all the same to me
terms.grammar: phrase: genitive of value with faciō, the thing accepted in the accusative
evidence: Ter. Heaut. 4.5.40: istuc aequī bonīque faciō (Lewis & Short s.v. aequus)
Plaut. Mil. 3.1.189: aequī istuc faciam, it will be all the same to me (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Att. 7.7: tranquillissimus animus meus tōtum istuc aequī bonī facit (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Literally “I reckon it as fair (and good)”: said of putting up with what one cannot change. Lewis & Short: “to put up with, be content with, submit to”.

phrases.latin: quod vērum an falsum sit, quoniam meā nihil interest, utrum mālim nesciō
phrases.english: whether it is true or false, since it makes no difference to me, I don’t know which I would prefer

phrases.latin: Meā quidem istuc nīl rēfert: tuā ego hoc faciō grātiā.
phrases.english: It makes no difference to me: I’m doing this for your sake.
it makes no difference: they are received with the same kindness
It amounts to the same thing.
